scope: Only successor root helper validate_usage and focused pure tests; preserve immutable predecessor; no usage infrastructure, session files, synthetic hook, RS writer, source, lease, budget or scheduler changes.
problem: Unconditional equality of expired captured exception reset and live reset rejects legitimate below-cap work after observed weekly reset.
decision: Add a separate explicit-expired/post-reset/below-cap branch. Preserve existing matching-reset path and all checkpoint arithmetic.
common_requirements: Fresh actual codex-usage via existing read-only call: status ok, should_pause exactly false; targeted current public RS status, no freeze. No fallback to cached quota.
Known finite numeric live and cached percentages in [0,100], excluding booleans. Existing decimal counter validation and strict projected checkpoint comparison unchanged. Live >= cached; live <99.

projected_points = points + (live - cached); next_absolute = (points - since_register) + printed_next_at_plus_N; require projected_points < next_absolute. Do not zero since_register or refund pre-reset accumulated points.

routes.matching_reset: Keep r4 captured_reset == live_reset behavior: live >=80 requires explicitly active exception. Below80 an explicit recognized active or expired state is sufficient; unknown states fail closed. Existing unknown, missing or mismatched resets remain rejected outside the one new branch.
routes.new_expired_post_reset: Only live <80 AND exception status exactly expired. Require positive strict integer captured_old_reset and live_reset, old < live_reset, and captured_old_reset <= cached_read_at <= live_checked_at <= now < live_reset. Require timezone-aware parseable cached read_at and live checked_at, finite actual now, and 0 <= now-live_checked_at <=60 seconds. Live read is obtained immediately before current targeted status by unchanged usage() sequence. cached read_at establishes post-reset bookkeeping epoch only; its stored fresh label and age are telemetry, not a quota authority or TTL. On any unknown, unsupported, future or inconsistent fact reject.

why_epoch_guard: Explicit expired status alone can be stale after a segment reset. Requiring an elapsed captured boundary and a post-boundary cached read prevents silently subtracting a reset from pre-reset bookkeeping. A normal existing hook may refresh stale bookkeeping; helper must not fabricate that action.
freshness_60_second_basis: New-branch checked_at bound covers existing sequential read-only calls (status subprocess timeout25 seconds) with buffer, without treating cached age as a meter. This is a proposed bounded freshness rule for the new branch, not a cached status expiry or authorization extension.
telemetry: explicit below-cap/no-exception-authority flag for new branch

approaches_rejected.ignore_exception_below80: Too broad: hides unknown reset/expiry state and fails the requested conservative post-reset diagnosis.
approaches_rejected.require_captured_reset_match_uncondition: Current false blocker; an expired grant belongs to its old window.
approaches_rejected.subtract_reset_or_restart_counters: Would erase accumulated cadence points and invent private accounting.
approaches_rejected.automatically_grant_or_refresh_exception: Unauthorized usage infrastructure or human-controlled exception mutation.

acceptance_bar: Root accepts design first; another worker creates immutable successor and test-first focused pure fixtures on both supported interpreters; independent source review before operational use. Original r4 and its reports remain unchanged. All pre-existing cache/allocation/catalogue/source/lease/budget tests remain passing; no real release operation in tests.
